test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A purchased two articles for Rs 400 and Rs 600 respectively and sold at gains of 10% and 20% respectively. What was his overall gain percentage?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (C.P) of first article = Rs.400

Profit on the first article = 10%

Cost price (C.P) of second article = Rs.600

Profit on the second article = 20%

**Formula used:**

Selling price (S.P) = Cost price (C.P) + {C.P × (100 ± P/L)%}

Profit = S.P - C.P

Profit% = (profit × 100)/C.P

**Calculation:**

S.P of first article = 400 × 110% = Rs.440

S.P of second article = 600 × 120% = Rs.720

Total C.P = 1000

Total S.P = 1160

Profit = 1160 - 1000 = Rs.160

Profit% = (160 × 100)/1000

⇒ 16%

**∴ The correct answer is 16%. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 

Calculation:

Let the overall profit = X %

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/661a7de74f0318bb59a51a98c697662cc94569b42e1d86cb2c0a286ff7c5a9a7.png] 

Now,

⇒ (X + 10)/(20 - X) = 600/400

⇒ (X + 10)/(20 - X) = 3/2

⇒ 2X + 20 = 60 - 3X

⇒ 5X = 80

⇒ X = 16%

∴ The correct answer is 16%.
